name: io.github.pineapplecare/jobber-mcp
description: Jobber connector with read tools and conservative client writes disabled by default.

environmentVariables.name: JOBBER_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID from your Jobber developer application (developer.getjobber.com)

environmentVariables.name: JOBBER_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client Secret from your Jobber developer application

environmentVariables.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional 64-char hex key. Leave unset to auto-generate one in the OS keychain (file fallback).

environmentVariables.name: JOBBER_REDIRECT_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Local port for the OAuth callback listener (default: 5679). Change if 5679 is in use.

environmentVariables.name: JOBBER_AUTH_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Jobber OAuth authorization endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: JOBBER_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Jobber OAuth token endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: JOBBER_GRAPHQL_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Pinned Jobber GraphQL API version sent as X-JOBBER-GRAPHQL-VERSION (default: 2025-04-16).

environmentVariables.name: JOBBER_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Blocks write tools. Defaults to true; set false only behind interactive approvals.

environmentVariables.name: TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Selects the MCP transport to start: stdio (default) or http.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public base URL used to build the OAuth callback link. Required when TRANSPORT=http.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional bearer token required on /mcp requests when set.
